summary: The study investigates the atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) of cubic silicon carbide (3-SiC) by alternating exposure to Si2H6 and C2H2 at 1050 °C. Self-limiting growth is observed for both silicon and carbon layers, with silicon growth ending at 1.3 ML and carbon growth at 1 ML. The spontaneous desorption of excess silicon during C2H2 exposure enables accurate layer-by-layer growth.
